pins.A: anode — the longer leg, toward + (the resistor / output pin)
pins.C: cathode — the shorter leg, toward GND

description: Lights up when current flows through it in the correct direction.
how_to_use: Connect the longer leg (anode) toward positive/the resistor, and the shorter leg (cathode) toward ground — reversed, it won't light.

plain.what: A tiny light. It only lights up when electricity flows through it the right way round.
plain.how: The longer leg goes towards + (through a resistor), the shorter leg towards − (GND). Always use a resistor (like 220 Ω) or the LED can burn out.

pins.C: the short leg (−), by the flat edge
